old_value: {"id":"jmap-chat-spec-qnf8","title":"State the three extension rules in scope/non-goals","description":"Mark 2026-10-21 discussion. Write three short rules side by side wherever the drafts state scope and non-goals (and in README/PROJECT): (1) trust and policy questions (who is verified, which credentials a gate accepts, age/membership) go to a deployment's oracle or policy hook, never into core MUSTs; (2) new data and new behaviour go to an extension capability in the proposer's own namespace (capability URN, extra maps, Other variants); (3) the core changes only with running code from two independent implementations. Keep the oracle interface minimal and non-normative: jmap-chat-vc-guide.md §9 already describes the credential oracle and makes unreachable behaviour (fail open/closed, keep-until-stale) an explicit operator setting (L380-393); per the operator-SHOULD rule this stays operator policy unless an oracle interface ever becomes normative, in which case its down-behaviour must be specified in the same change. Do not adopt any particular trust-registry format, oracle protocol or credential type as normative; defer to their own documents.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-21T23:32:29.44435621Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-21T23:32:29.44435621Z"}
